name: Password reset
description: Positive, negative and edge-case coverage for resetting a password via registered email.

test_cases.title: Reset request with registered email is accepted
test_cases.description: Submitting a registered email starts the reset flow.
test_cases.expected_result: Response is 202 with a generic confirmation message

test_cases.title: User sets a new password through a valid reset link and logs in
test_cases.description: End-to-end journey from reset link to logging in with the new password.
preconditions: A valid, unused reset link exists for registered.user@example.com
steps: Open the reset link in the browser
Enter the new password and confirm it
Log in with the new password
test_cases.expected_result: Password is updated and login with the new password succeeds

test_cases.title: Reset email arrives in the registered inbox with a working link
test_cases.description: Confirms the email is actually delivered and readable.
preconditions: Tester has access to the registered.user@example.com inbox
steps: Open the reset email and click the link
test_cases.expected_result: Email is received and the link opens the reset page

test_cases.title: Unregistered email gets the same generic response
test_cases.expected_result: Response status and message match the registered-email response; no email is sent

test_cases.title: Malformed email address is rejected
test_cases.description: Input validation on the reset request form.
test_cases.expected_result: A validation error is shown and no request is sent

test_cases.title: Expired reset link is rejected
test_cases.description: Depends on the unspecified expiry duration; uses a token past the configured expiry.
preconditions: A reset token exists that is past its expiry time
steps: POST /password-reset/confirm with the expired token and a new password
test_cases.expected_result: Response is 400 with an 'expired link' error and the password is unchanged

test_cases.title: Reset link cannot be used twice
preconditions: A reset token has already been used successfully
steps: POST /password-reset/confirm with the used token and another new password
test_cases.expected_result: Response is 400 and the password from the first reset still works

test_cases.title: Email lookup is case-insensitive
test_cases.description: Mixed-case input for a registered email should behave like the canonical email.
test_cases.expected_result: Response is 202 and a reset email is issued for the account
